from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')

def find_col(ws, keys):
    for cell in ws[1]:
        v = str(cell.value or '').lower()
        if any(k in v for k in keys):
            return cell.column
    return None

for ws in wb.worksheets:
    margin_col = find_col(ws, ['profit margin'])
    rev_col = find_col(ws, ['revenue', 'sales', 'income'])
    if margin_col or not rev_col:
        continue
    cost_col = find_col(ws, ['cost', 'cogs', 'expense'])
    prof_col = find_col(ws, ['profit'])
    if not cost_col and not prof_col:
        continue
    nc = ws.max_column + 1
    ws.cell(row=1, column=nc).value = 'Profit Margin (%)'
    ws.cell(row=1, column=nc).font = Font(bold=True)
    for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
        rv = ws.cell(row=r, column=rev_col)
        if rv.value is None:
            continue
        num = f'{ws.cell(row=r, column=prof_col).coordinate}' if prof_col else f'({rv.coordinate}-{ws.cell(row=r, column=cost_col).coordinate})'
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=nc)
        c.value = f'=IFERROR({num}/{rv.coordinate},"")'
        c.number_format = '0.0%'

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('ok')

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

def q(tag):
    return f'{{{NS}}}{tag}'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    items = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

root = ET.fromstring(items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sheetData = root.find(q('sheetData'))
rows = sheetData.findall(q('row'))
last_row = rows[-1].get('r')

hdr = rows[0]
c = ET.SubElement(hdr, q('c'))
c.set('r', 'H1'); c.set('s', '1'); c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
is_ = ET.SubElement(c, q('is')); t = ET.SubElement(is_, q('t')); t.text = 'Profit Margin (%)'

for row in rows[1:]:
    rn = row.get('r')
    c = ET.SubElement(row, q('c'))
    c.set('r', f'H{rn}'); c.set('s', '3')
    ET.SubElement(c, q('f')).text = f'IFERROR(G{rn}/E{rn},"")'
    ET.SubElement(c, q('v'))

root.find(q('dimension')).set('ref', f'A1:H{last_row}')
col = ET.SubElement(root.find(q('cols')), q('col'))
col.set('width', '15'); col.set('customWidth', '1'); col.set('min', '8'); col.set('max', '8')
items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

sroot = ET.fromstring(items['xl/styles.xml'])
numFmts = sroot.find(q('numFmts'))
numFmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numFmts, q('numFmt'))
nf.set('numFmtId', '164'); nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')
cellXfs = sroot.find(q('cellXfs'))
cellXfs.set('count', str(int(cellXfs.get('count')) + 1))
xf = ET.SubElement(cellXfs, q('xf'))
xf.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf.set('applyNumberFormat', '1')
xf.set('fontId', '0'); xf.set('fillId', '0'); xf.set('borderId', '0')
xf.set('pivotButton', '0'); xf.set('quotePrefix', '0'); xf.set('xfId', '0')
items['xl/styles.xml'] = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n, data in items.items():
        zout.writestr(n, data)
print('ok')

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

PATH = "sales_data.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(PATH)
ws = wb.active

headers = {}
for c in ws[1]:
    if c.value is not None:
        headers[c.column] = str(c.value).strip().lower()

def find_col(*names):
    for col, h in headers.items():
        if any(h == n or h.startswith(n) for n in names):
            return col
    return None

rev_col = find_col("revenue", "sales")
cost_col = find_col("cost", "cogs")
profit_col = find_col("profit")

if rev_col is None or (profit_col is None and cost_col is None):
    raise SystemExit("Cannot locate revenue/cost/profit columns needed for margin")

new_col = ws.max_column + 1
ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col, value="Profit Margin (%)")

last_row = ws.max_row
for r in range(2, last_row + 1):
    if all(ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value is None for c in headers):
        continue
    num = f"{get_column_letter(profit_col)}{r}" if profit_col else f"({get_column_letter(rev_col)}{r}-{get_column_letter(cost_col)}{r})"
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col)
    cell.value = f"=IFERROR({num}/{get_column_letter(rev_col)}{r},0)"
    cell.number_format = "0.0%"

wb.save(PATH)
print("headers:", headers)
print("rev_col:", rev_col, "cost_col:", cost_col, "profit_col:", profit_col, "new_col:", new_col, "last_row:", last_row)

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
NS = {"m": M}

with zipfile.ZipFile("sales_data.xlsx") as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("zip entries:", names)
    wbxml = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = []
    for s in wbxml.findall(".//m:sheets/m:sheet", NS):
        rid = s.get("{%s}id" % R)
        target = None
        rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        for rel in rels.findall("{%s}Relationship" % R):
            if rel.get("Id") == rid:
                target = rel.get("Target")
        sheets.append((s.get("name"), target))
    print("sheets:", sheets)

    strings = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss.findall("m:si", NS):
            parts = [t.text or "" for t in si.findall(".//m:t", NS)]
            strings.append("".join(parts))
    print("num shared strings:", len(strings))

    for name, target in sheets:
        path = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/") if target else None
        if path not in names:
            path = "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"
        print("--- sheet file:", path)
        sh = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        rows = sh.findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", NS)
        print("num rows:", len(rows))
        for row in rows[:6]:
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find("m:v", NS)
                val = v.text if v is not None else ""
                if t == "s" and val != "":
                    val = strings[int(val)]
                cells.append((ref, val))
            print(cells)

import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile

SRC = os.path.abspath("sales_data.xlsx")
soffice = shutil.which("soffice") or shutil.which("libreoffice")
if not soffice:
    raise SystemExit("soffice not found")

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
profile = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.makedirs(os.path.join(profile, "user"), exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(profile, "user", "registrymodifications.xcu"), "w") as f:
    f.write('''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<oor:items xmlns:oor="http://openoffice.org/2001/registry" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">

 <item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Office.Calc/Formula/Load"><prop oor:name="ODFRecalcMode" oor:op="fuse"><value>0</value></prop></item>
</oor:items>''')

cmd = [soffice, "--headless", "-env:UserInstallation=file://" + profile,
       "--convert-to", "xlsx", "--outdir", tmp, SRC]
r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
print("returncode:", r.returncode)
print("stdout:", r.stdout)
print("stderr:", r.stderr)

out = os.path.join(tmp, "sales_data.xlsx")
if os.path.exists(out):
    os.replace(out, SRC)
    print("replaced original with recalculated copy")
else:
    raise SystemExit("conversion produced no output file")

 <item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Office.Calc/Formula/Load"><prop oor:name="OOXMLRecalcMode" oor:op="fuse"><value>0</value></prop></item>

</oor:items>''')

cmd = [soffice, "--headless", "-env:UserInstallation=file://" + profile,
       "--convert-to", "xlsx", "--outdir", tmp, SRC]
r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
print("returncode:", r.returncode)
print("stdout:", r.stdout)
print("stderr:", r.stderr)

out = os.path.join(tmp, "sales_data.xlsx")
if os.path.exists(out):
    os.replace(out, SRC)
    print("replaced original with recalculated copy")
